_comment: Edit this to match your league. Everything downstream reads from here.
_playoff_note: ASSUMPTION - not in the ESPN export. Correct these if your league differs.
_thin_note: A week where this many rostered players are on bye counts as 'thin'.
_sigma_note: Std dev of a weekly fantasy score around its projection, used for expected wins. Raise it and every trade is worth fewer wins.
_schedule_note: ESPN's export carries no matchups, so wins use an all-play record. Supply {team: [opponent per week]} here (espn_pull.py can read it) for true projected wins.
_position_limits_note: Every team currently holds exactly 2 TQB / 4 RB / 4 WR / 2 TE / 2 D-ST / 2 K. If that uniformity is an enforced roster rule rather than a draft artifact, set this true to reject trades that change any team's positional counts.
